QuestInfo.name: Sand Bandits Test 1
QuestInfo.0: Helping the Sand Bandits are plan their raid of the queen's lands, Alpha and Beta hoped for a chance to steal the Goddess Teardrop. But before they had access to any of the Sand Bandit's resources, #b#p2420009##k would require another test to prove their loyalty.
QuestInfo.1: #p2420009#'s test of loyalty would require Alpha and Beta to post anti-queen posters on the walls of west #b#m322000000##k. They'd need to find the right place to make sure they were seen.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta passed #p2420009#'s test, and continued their quest for the Goddess Teardrop.

0.0: You're the strays that Ardin brought in? If you want us to trust you, #bput up the anti-queen poster#k in Ariant. Show us you believe in our cause.

yes.0: Find a #bsuitable wall#k in the western part of town, and put up that poster.

1.0: Did you put up the posters? That's good enough for me. You're definitely not working for the queen.
